svg.title: Separate retained evidence paths; assessment coverage is selective
svg.desc: Representation defines recorded coordinates. Historical births, proposals and native births have distinct denominators and scoring. Separately assessed exports have their own retained bundles. No arrow joins all search records to downstream assessment.
svg.metadata: Authored reporting diagram. g.text: Distinct accessions and counting units; no population-wide CAD or physical validation is implied.
N: 1,954,560 native births across ten completed runs
Separate scorers; birth counts do not measure assessment coverage.
Native per-birth CAD/assessment join: not retained.
Exact proposal links do not recover per-child parents.
Physical results: not reported. Current buckling inference: withdrawn.
